India Essential Oils holds ISO 9001:2015, WHO-GMP, USDA NOP Organic, Kosher, Halal, and FSSAI manufacturing certifications. Detailed registrar audit IDs and certificate downloads are available on our Certifications page.

Across India, domestic wholesale orders are dispatched via express surface/air cargo (Blue Dart, Safechem Logistics) within 24–48 hours of dispatch, with delivery typically in 2–5 business days depending on location.

We export globally to 50+ countries via IATA air freight (DHL, FedEx Express, Air Cargo) and LCL/FCL ocean freight from Nhava Sheva & Mundra ports. Standard international air transit is 4–7 business days.
Every export consignment includes full regulatory dossiers: GHS-compliant MSDS, Batch CoA, Technical Data Sheet (TDS), Phytosanitary Certificate, Non-GMO declaration, and Certificate of Origin.

Because botanical commodity prices fluctuate based on seasonal harvest yields, we provide real-time volume-tiered wholesale quotes. Click 'Request Quote' on any product page or contact our desk for an instant proforma invoice.

Most pure steam-distilled essential oils have a shelf life of 24–36 months when stored in sealed nitrogen-flushed containers in a cool, dark environment below 25°C. Citrus oils are best used within 12–18 months.

We utilize slow-steam distillation in 316-grade stainless steel stills for delicate flowers/leaves, and hydraulic cold-pressing for seed and citrus peel carrier oils to preserve volatile aromatic terpenes without thermal degradation.
Yes, we offer OEM private labeling, custom botanical blending, and bespoke terpene standardization for cosmetic, fragrance, and aromatherapy brands. Minimum batch runs start at 50kg.

For international orders we accept Wire Transfer (T/T Advance) and Irrevocable Letters of Credit (L/C at sight for large volumes). For domestic Indian orders, RTGS/NEFT and GST credit invoices are issued.
